name: pokerlab
description: A bilingual, local-first laboratory for poker probability, simulation, decision theory, and finite game solving.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn pokerlab_api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:rust
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.benchmark: cd apps/api && uv run python -m pokerlab_api.benchmarks
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter web format:check && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check . && cd ../.. && cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/poker-core/Cargo.toml --check
